gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund column: the Street column on p3 prints Transfers in 23,700 and Transfers out (973); neither is in detail, so both are added here (transfers out has no gap row because the statement Total column prints no transfers out). (2) Different basis: the statement Total Governmental Funds column nets through its Reclassifications column: Street 23,700 - 7,177 = 16,523. Detail records department-level gross transfers from the p8 General Fund schedule: transfers in General 9,155 + Social Security 7,546 + Unemployment 800 = 17,501, transfers between General Fund departments (General column on p3 prints no transfers in; its net (6,204) = 17,501 - 23,705 department transfers out). After the additions the transfers-in lines are 17,501 + 23,700 = 41,201 vs statement 16,523; the remaining 24,678 = 17,501 inter-department + 7,177 reclassification is gross-vs-netted presentation, not an error.
